brief_title: Triple Combination Therapy in Type 2 Diabetic Patients Who Had Inadequate Glycemic Control With Combination Therapy
official_title: Therapeutic Efficacy and Safety of Sitagliptin, Dapagliflozin and Lobeglitazone in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus Inadequately Controlled on Glimepiride and Metformin.
brief_summary: To assess the efficacy of treatment with sitagliptin or dapagliflozin or lobeglitazone in type 2 diabetes mellitus patients, who had inadequate glycemic control even though use of two drug combination therapy with glimepiride and metformin.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 20 ≤ Age \< 80 years
* HbA1c ≥ 7 %
* combination therapy with glimepiride and metformin over 2 months.
* dosage of glimepiride : 1-8mg/day
* dosage of metformin : 500-2550mg/day

Exclusion Criteria:

* Type 1 diabetes, gestational diabetes, or secondary forms of diabetes
* Contraindication to sitagliptin or dapagliflozin or lobeglitazone
* Pregnant or breast feeding women
* Medication which affect glycemic control (ex. steroid)
* Disease which affect efficacy and safety of drugs
* Any major illness (Liver disease, Renal failure, Heart disease, Cancer, etc)
* Not appropriate for oral antidiabetic agent
